protocol.hypothesis: The rejected unconditional tail replacement conflated terse symbol-focused lookups with broader collection requests. A complete code identifier can provide a stronger relevance signal in a terse request, while preserving broad-context and collection pools.

trial.description: Only full hybrid pools with at least two slots; no supplied files or failure; one or two whitespace words; exactly one complete compound-name clause; no registered collection word, numeric character or wildcard. If none of that clause's eligible complete matches is already represented, replace only the final record with the highest-ranked eligible complete match. Preserve the leading records, apply all eligibility/copy filters, and keep normal semantic/lexical thresholds.

protocol.selection: Run fixed development checks on complex, fullpool-retry and both retention suites first. Reject on any delivered fact/rank loss, negative identity/order change, visibility/trust/scope violation or token overrun. Then all historical development and unchanged crate contracts; only a safe improving candidate reaches reserved scoring. No cases, cutoffs or scope guards retuned from reserved outcomes.
protocol.limitations: Correlated exposed source incidents. This is a focused ranking policy, not a proof that every omitted tail is irrelevant. Full pools for collection/narrative/file/failure requests remain protected. No new independent or blind result.

guard_verification.counterexample: The initial whitespace-only collection check failed a new unit probe for all_crowding/all-crowding. Recognize registered collection words across punctuation separators and reject Unicode numeric characters too.
guard_verification.known_match_probe: An incumbent complete match can sit below 80 higher-ranked supplementary matches. A separate incumbent-only filtered scan must run before selecting a replacement, so pool truncation cannot hide an already supplied fact.

experiment_review.outcome: No safe gain beyond the first small mean-vector development result; replaced by MiniLM.

experiment_review.family: manual contextual keys and semantic gate; semantic-only; task-state ablation; structured capture
experiment_review.outcome: Grounded context can help, but manual aliases and false matches block generalization claims. Removing supplied files regressed.

experiment_review.outcome: No safe improvement, or gains coupled to negative/rank regressions.

experiment_review.outcome: Safe mechanism gains after preserving distinct facts, original text and packet limits.

experiment_review.outcome: Availability fixes recover missing representations without changing semantic thresholds.

protocol.hypothesis: MiniLM can represent terse topic fragments differently from grammatical requests. Supplement with one deterministic question/request view, using the unchanged normal threshold and preserving all incumbent ranks. No aliases or document rewrites.
protocol.eligibility: At most three whitespace words, nonempty distinctive FTS terms, no failure or supplied files, no exact incumbent task title, declared positive encoder limit and reformulated text fully inside that limit. Only unused result slots may be filled. Native-capable providers only; no relaxation of strict search.
protocol.selection: Fixed variants on original/fresh development first. Reject each variant for any individual answer/fact rank or delivery loss, negative IDs/order change, scope or budget violation. Replay all historical development views and crate contracts before reserved scoring. A safe development gain may ship with unchanged exposed reserved recall; do not retune on reserved outcomes.
protocol.stopping: If no view passes development, restore baseline and record failures before trying a different mechanism.
protocol.limitations: All fixtures and reserved incidents are already exposed. No new independent cases, blind semantic result or live-agent success claim.
protocol.decision: All three fixed query views reproduce original/fresh development recall with no gains; removed. No reserved trial was scored.

rejected_query_views.decision: No expected-answer gain; all three removed. Only development scored. Question view changed one positive returned pool and solution view changed three, without recovering an answer.

decision: Ship focused complete-symbol rescue; all current benchmark inputs and denominators unchanged. Scope guards and incumbent presence are checked before replacement. This deliberately replaces one returned tail in eligible focused pools; absence of observed requested-fact regressions is not a universal usefulness judgment on every displaced tail.

guard_probes.collection_separator: all_crowding/all-crowding failed the initial whitespace-only guard; lexical-token guard fixed it before reserved scoring.
guard_probes.bounded_pool: A supplied complete match below the top 80 supplementary rows was incorrectly replaceable; incumbent-only filtering before that limit now preserves it.
